claims.text: BBC Radio 4's The Cost of Food, recorded at the Abergavenny Food Festival in September 2026, asked for new ideas, and this article adds one from a direction the food debate rarely looks at.
claims.quote: one line stayed with me: we need new ideas

claims.text: Much of the fear around AI is manufactured by the investor ecosystem that sells frontier models, producing an AI fatigue in which rational people stop looking.
claims.quote: I think much of that fear is manufactured

claims.text: Sustain's Unpicking Food Prices found that on a kilo of supermarket apples at 2.20 pounds the grower's costs were 76p and their profit 3p, about 1% of the shelf price.
claims.quote: the grower's costs were 76p and their profit 3p, about 1% of the shelf price

value.unit: pence of grower profit per kilo of apples

claims.text: For a wrapped sliced loaf at 1.14 pounds, the cereal farmer spent 9.03p to grow the wheat in it and kept 0.09p.
claims.quote: the cereal farmer spent 9.03p to grow the wheat in it and kept 0.09p

value.unit: pence of farmer profit per loaf

claims.text: One survey found two thirds of companies treating Excel as a supply chain system, and another found spreadsheets the primary operational tool for nearly half of supply chain professionals.
claims.quote: found two thirds of companies treating Excel as a supply chain system

value.unit: companies treating Excel as a supply chain system

claims.text: The FAO's Food Loss Index puts the share of food lost between harvest and retail at 13.3% in 2023, slightly worse than when monitoring began in 2015.
claims.quote: at 13.3% in 2023, slightly worse than when monitoring began in 2015

value.unit: percent of food lost before retail

claims.text: The big buyer is the one party with real systems, and once it holds 20%, 30% or 40% of a farm's output it can name the price, because the farm has no other distribution channel.
claims.quote: it can name the price, because the farm has no other distribution channel and cannot afford to lose the volume

claims.text: This is not malice but the mechanism Giblin and Doctorow call a chokepoint: a powerful buyer locks in its sellers, makes the market hostile to alternatives, and takes more than its share of the value.
claims.quote: a powerful buyer locks in the people who sell to it, makes the market hostile to alternatives, and then uses that position to take more than its share of the value

claims.text: The Groceries Code Adjudicator's 2025 survey found 30% of suppliers reporting a code issue, down from 33%, with perceived compliance from 98% at the best retailer to 66% at Amazon.
claims.quote: 30% of suppliers reported a code issue, down from 33%

value.unit: percent of suppliers reporting a code issue

claims.text: The UK's code and fair dealing rules regulate the conduct of the party with the systems and leave the party without them exactly where it was; a compliance regime is one only big buyers can afford to follow.
claims.quote: they regulate the conduct of the party with the systems, and leave the party without them exactly where it was

claims.text: The chokepoint is made of information held by one party and the systems that hold it; logistics is a data problem before it is a transport problem.
claims.quote: logistics is a data problem before it is a transport problem

claims.text: A supply chain of vaults: every party holds its own encrypted, versioned vault and key, orders and answers travel over append lanes, one typed graph joins the vocabularies, and no platform in the middle sees every farm's numbers.
claims.quote: No platform in the middle sees every farm's numbers.

claims.text: Two agent teams ran two-way, signed messaging between vaults on 25 and 26 September without either holding the other's key.
claims.quote: between vaults on 25 and 26 September, without either holding the other's key

claims.text: The 13% the FAO counts is invisible today because it falls between records nobody joins; typed edges across vaults make waste a query rather than an argument on the phone.
claims.quote: The 13% the FAO counts is invisible today because it falls between records nobody joins.

claims.text: The chain of vaults does not stop a buyer holding 40% of a farm's output from naming a price; it makes costs, terms and alternatives visible and the next buyer reachable at the cost of a read key.
claims.quote: It does not stop a buyer that holds 40% of a farm's output from naming a price.

claims.text: Use GenAI not to use GenAI: the model is used once to build the tool that runs in the line, and in production there is no model.
claims.quote: In production, in the line, there is no model.

claims.text: A grower describes their piece of the chain in their own words, an agent turns it into a working tool in an afternoon with the vault as its store, and a small company runs it, paid because it keeps working.
claims.quote: Then a small company takes the finished tool and runs it

claims.text: That order matters because the tool fits, it is cheap to run on plain files, and it is open by default so the next grower starts from the last one's work.
claims.quote: That order matters for three reasons.

claims.text: A supply chain run this way brings the price of food and goods down.
claims.quote: My hypothesis is that a supply chain run this way brings the price of food and goods down.

claims.text: McKinsey reported in 2021 that early adopters of AI-enabled supply chain management improved logistics costs by 15%, inventory levels by 35% and service levels by 65%.
claims.quote: improved logistics costs by 15%, inventory levels by 35% and service levels by 65%

claims.text: The FAO's own estimate of the value of food lost before retail is about 400 billion US dollars a year.
claims.quote: its own estimate of the value lost is about USD 400 billion a year

value.unit: US dollars a year of food lost

claims.text: Nobody has measured the effect on a farm, a packer or a wholesaler of tools that fit them, records typed once, and a second buyer reachable at the cost of a read key; that is the experiment.
claims.quote: What nobody has measured is the effect on a farm, a packer or a wholesaler of tools that fit them

claims.text: Government money should go into the tooling, the shared vocabularies and the villager companies rather than regulation, because it is cheaper than a subsidy and compounds.
claims.quote: It is cheaper than a subsidy and, unlike a subsidy, it compounds.

claims.text: The ONS found the price of laptops, PCs and tablets fell 76% between 2005 and 2016, and it did not stop anybody buying a computer.
claims.quote: the price of laptops, PCs and tablets fell 76% between 2005 and 2016

value.unit: percent fall in computer prices 2005 to 2016

claims.text: The BIS looked at 140 years of data across 38 economies and found the link between falling goods prices and lower growth weak and largely from the Great Depression; the deflations that hurt were in asset prices with debt attached.
claims.quote: found the link between falling goods prices and lower growth to be weak, and to come largely from the Great Depression

claims.text: People do not share for two reasons, that it is not easy and that they believe ideas are precious; the voice memo to published article workflow is what made sharing cheap for the owner.
claims.quote: Before I had it, the cost of sharing an idea was a week, and so most ideas were never shared.

claims.text: The European Commission estimates about 80% of industrial data is never used, and cites OECD work putting the benefit of more business-to-business data sharing at 1% to 2.5% of GDP.
claims.quote: about 80% of industrial data is never used

value.unit: percent of industrial data never used

claims.text: China and the other economies that build on open-weight models have a large advantage: their companies run a near-frontier model inside their own environment and innovate on top of it.
claims.quote: their companies can run a near-frontier model inside their own environment and innovate on top of it

claims.text: The Two Loops paper says Alibaba's Qwen models alone have over 100,000 derivatives on Hugging Face, and that the open ecosystem lets China innovate close to the frontier despite compute constraints.
claims.quote: with Alibaba's Qwen models alone having over 100,000 derivatives on Hugging Face

value.unit: derivatives of Qwen on Hugging Face

claims.text: DeepSeek's V3 needed 2.788 million GPU hours, priced at about 5.6 million US dollars, and by one count Chinese open-weight models were about 61% of the tokens served through OpenRouter by May 2026.
claims.quote: Chinese open-weight models were about 61% of the tokens served through OpenRouter by May 2026

value.unit: percent of OpenRouter tokens from Chinese open-weight models

claims.text: Switzerland's Apertus, released in September 2025 with weights, data and method open, covers more than a thousand languages with 40% of its training data in languages other than English.
claims.quote: covers more than a thousand languages with 40% of its training data in languages other than English

value.unit: percent of training data not in English

claims.text: The safety objection to open-weight models has a plain answer: they run inside the company's own environment, often air-gapped, and bias is managed by the harness as it must be for every model.
claims.quote: there is no call home and no data leaving unless the company sends it

claims.text: Every piece named exists on sgit today: encrypted vaults with git semantics, read keys, append lanes and the messaging on them, typed graphs across vaults, and vault apps with declared permissions.
claims.quote: Every piece named in the second figure exists on sgit and is published on this site

claims.text: What does not exist is the chain: nobody has put a grower, a packer and a buyer on vaults and run a season through them, the grading vocabularies are unwritten, and the villager companies for agriculture do not exist.
claims.quote: Nobody has put a grower, a packer and a buyer on vaults and run a season through them.

claims.text: Both spreadsheet surveys were run by software vendors with an interest in the answer, so the exact figures should be treated with care.
claims.quote: Both surveys were run by software vendors with an interest in the answer, so treat the exact figures with care.
